note: The title screen. Mouse-driven: every item is clickable and no key is required. CONTINUE greys out with no save rather than disappearing, so the menu is the same length every time. There is no music -- the score does not exist, and errata invariant 5 makes its detuning the emotional arc of the whole game, so a placeholder would be actively misleading. musicCue is the hook and nothing plays it.

title.note: Doc 17, revised. HIERARCHY, not uniform sizing: the 1990 reference sets its connective words small and its key word enormous, and fitting five words at one size was the wrong problem. CLAIM is the word carrying the double meaning the title rests on -- a mining claim and an assertion -- so it is the largest thing on the screen. The sizes are content because the layout is a design decision, not a rendering detail.
